# First, let's check the raw PDF more thoroughly using pdfplumber directly
extract_script = """
import pdfplumber

pdf_path = "testbed/docs/handbook.pdf"
all_text = []

with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:
    print(f"Total pages: {len(pdf.pages)}")
    for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):
        text = page.extract_text()
        if text:
            all_text.append(f"--- Page {i+1} ---")
            all_text.append(text)
        else:
            all_text.append(f"--- Page {i+1} (no text) ---")

full_text = "\\n\\n".join(all_text)
print(f"Total extracted chars: {len(full_text)}")
print("--- FULL CONTENT ---")
print(full_text)
"""
await write_file("./extract_handbook.py", extract_script)
print("Script written")

pdfplumber_output = await run_command("python ./extract_handbook.py")
print(pdfplumber_output)

# Also try PyMuPDF (fitz) for a second opinion
fitz_script = """
import fitz

pdf_path = "testbed/docs/handbook.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)
print(f"Total pages: {len(doc)}")

all_text = []
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    text = page.get_text()
    if text.strip():
        all_text.append(f"--- Page {i+1} ---")
        all_text.append(text.strip())

full_text = "\\n\\n".join(all_text)
print(f"Total extracted chars: {len(full_text)}")
print("--- FULL CONTENT ---")
print(full_text)
doc.close()
"""
await write_file("./extract_fitz.py", fitz_script)
